en: A black and white photograph showing a group of people, likely a family, standing at the edge of the sea on a sandy beach. The group consists of an adult man and several children in early twentieth-century swimwear. The scene is candid and appears vintage, possibly from the early 1900s to 1930s. No distinct buildings, monuments, or signage is visible—just the figures, the shoreline, and ocean waves.
